# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 5 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 5:4 — breathed into you the spirit vs. breath of life

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the spirit of life" | Latin spiritum vitae — more theological |
| LOGOS | "the breath of life" | Closer to Gen 2:7 LXX/Vulgate |
| PNEUMA | "the breath of life" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA prefer 'breath of life,' aligning with Genesis 2:7. The Latin spiritum can mean either; 'breath' is more accurate to the creation narrative context. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
